generationPromptZh: 一个带直角侧框及开放层板隔间的几何书架。它由左右侧板、顶板、底板和中间层板组成。层板厚度约为框宽的0.15倍，形成2层开放隔间。宽深比约1.62，高/最大水平跨度约1.62；隔层空隙位于左右侧板之间，底层空隙与侧板高比0.47。实测采用2种不透明颜色，侧板以棕色为主，层板呈浅棕色。正视看前侧轮廓，侧视看纵深及附件连接，俯视看水平排列和间距；斜视同时显示前面、右侧与顶部，孔隙与接合均来自实体几何。 采用彩色体素。坐标为0至47的整数，X左右、Y向上、Z前后；实际接地最低Y为0。占用750至1250个唯一体素，RGB为0至255整数；保持单一六邻域连通、真实开口及面连接。不要添加展示底板、文字、背景、噪声或悬浮装饰。 原始参数规格：{"baseWidthFraction": 0.55, "category": "bookshelf", "changedAttributes": ["width", "depth", "height", "supportInset", "shapeChamfer", "featureCount"], "construction": "original continuous boxes and chamfered cross sections", "depth": 8.0, "detailPosition": 0.25, "featureCount": 2, "height": 22.0, "instance": 0, "lipOverhang": 0.6, "neckFraction": 0.42, "ordinal": 47616, "redesign": 0, "rimHeight": 2.0, "shapeChamfer": 0.0, "shoulderFraction": 0.58, "structureIndex": 0, "style": 0, "supportInset": 1.0, "variant": 1, "wallThickness": 2.0, "width": 14.0}
generationPromptEn: A geometric bookshelf with rectangular side frames and open shelf compartments. It includes left and right side panels, top and bottom panels and intermediate shelves. Shelves are 0.15 frame-widths thick, forming 2 open rows. Width/depth is 1.62; height/horizontal-span is 1.62. Shelf gaps remain between the side panels. Lower-gap/side-height is 0.47. Across 2 opaque colors, the sides is mainly brown and the shelves is tan. Front and side views expose contours and attachment joins; top and oblique views reveal spacing and upper surfaces. Use colored voxels at unique integer coordinates from 0 through 47, with X left to right, Y upward and Z front to back. Real ground contact starts at Y zero. Use 750 through 1250 occupied voxels and integer RGB values from 0 through 255. Keep one six neighbor component, real openings and face connected parts. Add no display base, text, background, noise or floating ornaments.
